package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/specterops/dawgs/drivers/pg"
	"github.com/specterops/dawgs/graph"
	"github.com/specterops/dawgs/opengraph"
	"github.com/specterops/dawgs/util/size"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: dawgs-v1-export <graph-name> <output>")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	connStr := os.Getenv("PGCONN")
	if connStr == "" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PGCONN is required")
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	poolCfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(connStr)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to parse pool configuration: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	pool, err := pg.NewPool(poolCfg)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to connect: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer pool.Close()

	db := pg.NewDriver(size.Gibibyte, pool)
	if err := db.SetDefaultGraph(context.Background(), graph.Graph{Name: os.Args[1]}); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to select graph: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	outFile := os.Args[2]

	f, err := os.Create(outFile)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to create file: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer f.Close()

	if err := opengraph.Export(context.Background(), db, f); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "export failed: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "exported graph to %s\n", outFile)
}
